content.comment_body: Hello, Not all variables from my device shadow are being published to the 'update' topic on the cloud interface. How can this be resolved? *** In the meantime, I found the cause. In the cloud data transfer settings of my device, I selected 'At frequency' for all variables. After doing this, all variables appeared in the cloud and were accepted in the device shadow.

analysis.insight_summary: The user initially reported that some variables from the device shadow were missing in the cloud 'update' topic when connecting their hardware. After checking the cloud data transfer settings, selecting 'At frequency' for all variables resolved the issue, and all variables became visible in the cloud device shadow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all device shadow variables to be reliably published and accessible through the cloud interface.
